smoke_command: python -m pytest tests/phase_14 -q && python -m medfm.cli.train --config configs/recipes/3d/classification_smoke.yaml && python -m medfm.tools.validate_phase --phase 14

criteria.description: Native 3D classification and segmentation, native 3D VLM, slice-sequence VLM, and language-conditioned 3D segmentation are distinct typed recipe families.
criteria.evidence: All twelve configs under configs/recipes/3d parse and build through build_phase14_recipe; focused tests pass for every family and the validator checks all five family declarations.

criteria.description: CT-FM/FlexiCT, MRI/Triad, and a generic MONAI-compatible 3D baseline are published with pinned revisions and explicit modality/channel semantics.
criteria.evidence: classification_ct_fm_cuda.yaml, classification_flexict3d.yaml, classification_triad_mri.yaml, and classification_ct_fm_tpu_bf16.yaml are present; MRI batches are MRI_3D with two sequence channels and CT batches remain CT_3D.

criteria.description: Dataset-fingerprint input policy resolves to a bounded static 3D bucket table.
criteria.evidence: select_volume_input_policy preserves global/local shapes, filters non-volume fingerprint entries, and the focused policy test plus validator pass.

criteria.description: Native 3D segmentation uses a decoder-first baseline, positive-lesion sampling, padding masks, optional deep supervision, and configurable sliding-window blending.
criteria.evidence: Both baseline and Triad LoRA segmentation configs build and complete one CPU optimizer step; tests assert positive_patch_rate, voxel masks, Gaussian blending, and fixed shapes.

criteria.description: Native 3D segmentation reports clinical-unit-aware Dice, surface/HD95, lesion recall, false positives per scan, and volume error.
criteria.evidence: native_3d_segmentation_metrics returns all six metric families and the exact-target evaluation test verifies units and perfect-lesion behavior.

criteria.description: Crop origin, spacing, and original-space restoration remain explicit in native 3D segmentation outputs.
criteria.evidence: Segmentation batches carry SpatialMetadata and crop_origin; restore_volume_mask_to_original is tested on a 3D crop with original bounds.

criteria.description: Native 3D VLM bridges spatial tokens through physical coordinate embeddings with fixed visual/text buckets and cached-token support.
criteria.evidence: The cached TPU and CUDA LoRA VLM profiles build; tests verify [B,N,3] source coordinates, 32/64 visual buckets, cache provenance, Perceiver output, and image/no-image/shuffle modes.

criteria.description: Slice-sequence VLM remains a separate multi-image experiment with host-side fixed-count selection and preserved geometry metadata.
criteria.evidence: slice_sequence_vlm_uniform.yaml builds MULTI_IMAGE_2D [B,I,C,H,W] batches; selector tests and recipe tests preserve index, normalized/physical z, series order, window, sequence, and revision.

criteria.description: Language-conditioned 3D segmentation uses fixed query buckets, cross-attention, masks, and separate grounding metrics.
criteria.evidence: The language-conditioned recipe builds spatial masks for explicit query tensors and the focused tests cover absent, multiple, laterality, and ambiguous behavior plus separate mask/grounding metric outputs.

criteria.description: Global-batch semantics, memory cap, and backend observability are recorded rather than inferred from runtime failures.
criteria.evidence: Phase14RecipeMetadata serializes the batch formula, shape/token buckets, memory cap, compiler/input-wait/throughput/HBM/VRAM/fallback fields; pipeline smokes complete with the configured effective batch.

criteria.description: One-batch training and checkpoint resume are covered by the Phase 14 contract suite.
criteria.evidence: test_phase14_pipeline_one_batch_smoke_and_checkpoint_resume completes one optimizer step, finds checkpoints/last, and restores global step 1.

criteria.description: Phase 14 focused tests and the acceptance validator pass.
criteria.evidence: python -m pytest tests/phase_14 -q reports 19 passed; python -m pytest tests/phase_13 -q reports 19 passed; the Phase 14 validator has no recipe or required-file errors.

criteria.description: At least one 3D task executes on accepted TPU hardware and every remaining model has an explicit TPU status.
criteria.justification: This workstation has no torch_xla/PJRT TPU runtime. TPU BF16 profiles are published with static buckets, generic-baseline status, and explicit non-accepted replicated hardware flags; no hardware result is claimed.

criteria.description: Production evidence gates and blocked checkpoint/dependency constraints are explicit.
criteria.evidence: docs/recipes/phase14_3d_model_cards.md and agent/reports/phase_14/unresolved_issues.md state that offline tiny/synthetic results are contract evidence only and preserve fail-closed production handoffs.
